tagline: Empowering communities and making their knowledge accessible to everyone
hero_kpi_rationale: Daily Active Uniques (DAUq) is the hero KPI because it directly captures growth in user engagement on the platform, the fundamental driver of advertising monetization and Reddit's community network strategy.

kpis.name: Daily Active Users
kpis.explanation: Average number of unique users visiting Reddit each day.
kpis.description: DAUq is the primary platform usage indicator. Up 19% year-over-year, it reflects the effectiveness of growth levers such as automatic translation and marketing.

kpis.name: Annual Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company over one year.
kpis.description: Revenue increased significantly due to improved monetization, particularly in advertising and user engagement.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs.
kpis.description: The 91.2% gross margin in 2025 indicates a lean cost structure and high scalability of the business model.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, typical of digital platforms

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA surged to $845.1 million in 2025, up from $298 million in 2024, driven by revenue growth and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.description: FCF reached $684.2 million in 2025, up from $215.8 million in 2024, supported by rising revenue and operational discipline.

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per User
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated on average per daily active user.
kpis.description: Quarterly ARPU was $5.98 for the three months ended December 2025, up 42% year-over-year, reflecting improved advertising efficiency.

kpis.name: Daily Active Users
kpis.explanation: Average number of unique users visiting Reddit each day.
kpis.description: DAUq reached 121.4 million in Q4 2025, up 19% year-over-year, driven by 28% growth outside the United States.

kpis.name: Annual Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company over one year.
kpis.description: Annual revenue reached $2.2 billion in 2025, growing 69%, marking a turning point in platform monetization.

risks.title: Loss or failure to retain users
risks.score_rationale: Loss or failure to retain users is explicitly mentioned in the report as a primary risk. If Reddit fails to increase or retain its user base, particularly DAUq, the business would be directly impacted.

risks.title: Decline in user contributions
risks.score_rationale: If users do not contribute content or their contributions are not engaging, it could lead to declining engagement and loss of advertisers.

risks.title: Dependence on brand and reputation
risks.score_rationale: The business relies heavily on strong brand and reputation. Failure to maintain or enhance brand and reputation would affect the ability to expand the user and advertiser base.

risks.title: Dependence on advertising
risks.score_rationale: The majority of revenue comes from advertising. Changes in advertising budgets or macroeconomic conditions could significantly affect revenue growth.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and advertising uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The report states that inflation, high interest rates, tariffs, and geopolitical risks create uncertainty in the advertising market and impact brands' willingness to invest.

risks.title: Competition for user engagement and advertising budgets
risks.score_rationale: Reddit continues to face intense competition for both user engagement and advertising budgets, which could negatively impact advertising revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: The company RDDT does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report.
